data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2 (OpenAI path): LiteLLM transport for OpenAI provider documented alongside Anthropic

## Gap finding
DD2 requires transport documentation for BOTH Anthropic and OpenAI. T3 only covers Anthropic. This task adds an OpenAI stub provider and extends transport-report.md with an OpenAI section.

## Implementation
- Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/providers/openai.py (stub with same interface as anthropic.py; may raise NotImplementedError for actual call — implementation in S3)
- Extend tests/fixtures/ci-review-transport-report.md with OpenAI transport section (LiteLLM model string format "openai/gpt-4o", auth env var OPENAI_API_KEY, transport)
- Extend test_transport_verify.py or add test that openai provider is importable

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh passes
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] ruff check passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] providers/openai.py exists and is importable
  Verify: PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts python3 -c "from dso_ci_review.providers import openai"
- [ ] transport-report.md contains OpenAI section
  Verify: grep -qi "openai" tests/fixtures/ci-review-transport-report.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
data.title: Add OpenAI provider stub and transport documentation to satisfy DD2
